main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (5-day return minus coin's mean 5-day return), non-overlapping 5-bar cells, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 non-zero cells

decided_by: t lies between -2 and 2 with at least 300 non-zero cells, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The mean and t are taken over the non-zero-forecast cells only, which are the cells the plan's minimum counts. Each coin's mean 5-day return is the mean over all its valid grid cells in all windows. Cells whose 5-day return would leave the window are dropped.
